codeReview.summary: The commit completes the main field renames, but it does not fully satisfy VAL-BR-004 because narrative identifiers remain in world_life.py and one projection-element identifier in constants.py is still narrative.

issues.description: world_life.py still exposes narrative actor identifiers (`scribe_aya`, `cantor_ren`, `keeper_mio`, `witness_kai`, `weaver_noa` at lines 34, 42, 50, 58, and 66). `build_interaction_response` also still uses the narrative `pray` action at line 111. That means the feature did not fully replace narrative terms in functional world_life.py data/API surfaces.

PROJECTION_ELEMENTS still contains the narrative machine identifier `nexus.ui.inspiration_atlas`. The feature description and naming map require projection elements to use neutral names (`Inspiration Atlas` -> `System Overview`), but only the title was updated; the functional id remains narrative and is consumed elsewhere in the app.

blockingIssues.description: Narrative actor ids remain in the emitted world-life payload, and the interaction path still uses `pray`, so the file is not fully de-narrativized.
`nexus.ui.inspiration_atlas` was left in PROJECTION_ELEMENTS even though this feature was supposed to update projection-element naming to neutral equivalents.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The naming map documents panel-name renames, but it does not explicitly say whether projection-element machine ids/tags must be renamed too. The worker changed the title to `System Overview` but left the narrative id `nexus.ui.inspiration_atlas`, which is also referenced by frontend layout/config code.

For rename work, the shared procedure should explicitly call out ids/slugs alongside display text. This worker's transcript shows searches for capitalized role names only, which missed lower-case role-derived ids that still ship in world_life.py.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Residual ids at part64/code/world_life.py:34,42,50,58,66; transcript skeleton entry in worker-transcripts.jsonl line 11 shows grep patterns for `Scribe|Cantor|Keeper|Witness|Field Weaver` but not `scribe_|cantor_|keeper_|witness_|weaver_`.

summary: Fail. The feature handled the headline field renames and updated the targeted tests, but narrative identifiers still remain in world_life.py and PROJECTION_ELEMENTS, so VAL-BR-004 is not fully met.
